name: harvest-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Harvest CRM + Accounting

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions

//engines: Pinned to 22, not the repo root's 24: all 5 functions here are GCF 1st gen (v1), and nodejs24 is 2nd-gen only, so it can't deploy (THE-99). 22 is the highest 1st gen supports, and clears the Node 20 EOL on Cloud Functions (2026-10-30). The Next.js app at the repo root targets 24 for Vercel instead — the two are intentionally different.
